metadata.question: Does the vegetation cover in Robinson Crusoe Island show higher greenness compared to Santa Clara Island in November 2018?

data.raw_code: The question is comparing vegetation greenness between two islands in November 2018. I need to: 1. Strategy: - Use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as a proxy for greenness - Use Sentinel-2 data for good spatial resolution and NDVI calculation - Define geometries for both islands (Robinson Crusoe and Santa Clara) - Filter for November 2018 - Calculate mean NDVI for each island and compare 2. Data Quality & Logic: - Check if collections are empty for either island - Check if valid pixels remain after cloud masking - Validate NDVI values are in reasonable range (-1 to 1) - Compare the mean NDVI values 3. Locations: - Robinson Crusoe Island: approx -33.6411, -78.8417 - Santa Clara Island: approx -33.7000, -78.9500 I'll use buffered points around these coordinates to represent the islands. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries for the islands const robinsonCrusoe = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.8417, -33.6411]).buffer(2000); const santaClara = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.9500, -33.7000]).buffer(1500); // Date range for November 2018 const startDate = '2018-11-01'; const endDate = '2018-11-30'; // Get Sentinel-2 collection let s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); // Check collection size const colSize = s2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images in period: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Function to calculate NDVI and mask clouds function processImage(img) { // Cloud masking using QA60 band const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); // Calculate NDVI const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return img.addBands(ndvi).updateMask(mask); } // Process collection s2Col = s2Col.map(processImage).select('NDVI'); // Create composite const composite = s2Col.median(); // Calculate mean NDVI for each island const robinsonStats = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: robinsonCrusoe, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const santaClaraStats = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: santaClara, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const robinsonData = robinsonStats.getInfo(); const santaClaraData = santaClaraStats.getInfo(); console.log(`Robinson: NDVI=${robinsonData.NDVI_mean?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${robinsonData.NDVI_count}`); console.log(`Santa Clara: NDVI=${santaClaraData.NDVI_mean?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${santaClaraData.NDVI_count}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (!robinsonData.NDVI_count || !santaClaraData.NDVI_count || robinsonData.NDVI_count === 0 || santaClaraData.NDVI_count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (robinsonData.NDVI_mean === null || santaClaraData.NDVI_mean === null || isNaN(robinsonData.NDVI_mean) || isNaN(santaClaraData.NDVI_mean) || Math.abs(robinsonData.NDVI_mean) > 1 || Math.abs(santaClaraData.NDVI_mean) > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare NDVI values if (robinsonData.NDVI_mean > santaClaraData.NDVI_mean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
